_comment: First matching rule wins (globs on the exported file path). denoise: how far the model may move away from the original; low keeps layout and text, high invents more detail.
style: hand-painted 2D game art, clean detailed illustration, crisp edges, rich warm colours, soft consistent lighting, 1990s Italian pizzeria business game remastered in high definition
negative: blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, deformed, extra limbs, noisy, low resolution
